controller.clock_errors_only: Admission backlog prediction is unchanged; only fairness-state decay uses the biased service clock.

mlp.extrapolation: Linear interpolation through batch 1/8/32; the 8-to-32 slope extends to batch 64.

limitations: The service model inherits all E49-E55 limitations and is not a live serving-engine measurement.
Clock errors are synthetic sensitivity controls and do not represent a calibrated production predictor-error distribution.
Class-specific bias is applied only to the 6144-token prompt class; real errors also vary with batch, prefix position, hardware state, and decode occupancy.
Cache-blind service uses no-cache candidate prefill cost and isolates missed prefix reuse in the fairness clock, not in admission or execution.
The controller still optimizes equal prompt-class acceptance rather than tenant, token, or utility-weighted fairness.
model: The E55 rotating-prompt service-decay controller with isolated uniform, class-specific, and cache-blind fairness-clock errors.

validation.accounting: The v40 base asserts exact accepted prefill/decode tokens, causal pairs, finite completion only for accepted requests, max batch 64, and KV within budget. Phase counts are exact, decayed accepted weight never exceeds offered weight, global bias orders effective history monotonically, every admitted request satisfies its unchanged admission threshold, and hard slices report zero violations.
